>
> 本版本为 MetroVerse v1.3.0 的预发布测试版本（Pre-release），供抢先体验与验证后再转为正式稳定版。

## What’s new

- **InnerTube & reliability:** Upgraded the InnerTube playback engine (`InnerTubeX v0.13.0` with QuackJS), anti-bot attestation, encrypted credential storage, database backup safety, and cache management.
- **First-launch usage mode:** Added a startup choice between Music + Podcasts and Podcasts-only mode (hides Home and defaults Library and Search to Podcasts; changeable anytime in Settings → Appearance → Misc).
- **Content filtering:** Added explicit-only mode, AI artist blocklist, video and short-song filters, and hiding YouTube podcasts without affecting Open RSS podcasts.
- **Apple Music visual enhancements:** Added animated album covers, artist images, and artist profile videos, with resolution controls and a mobile-data toggle.
- **Unified lyrics & player transition:** Enabled Apple Music word-by-word lyrics by default for all users, with live preview, text size and line spacing sliders, progressive blur, album-cover zoom when toggling lyrics, and bottom provider and songwriter credits.
- **Modern player & app icons:** Standardized on the updated player and mini-player designs, restored the adaptive dark-mode default icon, and added an App icon switcher (Default and Piano Black) in Settings → Appearance.
- **Fixes:** Fixed Google/YouTube WebView sign-in, playback queue resolution from Home and Search, returning to Podcasts from search via the bottom navigation bar, lyrics seek responsiveness, instant lyrics animation style switching, artist video aspect ratio and bottom fade, and Discord Rich Presence / Last.fm scrobbling reliability.

## Before you update

- Requires **Android 8.0 or newer and an ARM64 device**.
- Signed with the same release certificate as prior MetroVerse builds for direct upgrade compatibility.
- Open RSS podcasts and playlists remain isolated from YouTube-only content filters.
- Apple Music animated covers, artist images, and artist videos are optional and include resolution and mobile-data controls.
- Apple Music word-by-word lyrics animation is enabled by default for all users and can be changed anytime in Settings → Appearance → Lyrics.

## 主要更新

- **InnerTube 与基础可靠性：** 升级 InnerTube 播放引擎（`InnerTubeX v0.13.0` 与 QuackJS）、反爬认证、本地凭据加密存储、数据库备份安全及缓存管理。
- **首次启动使用模式：** 新增「音乐 + 播客」与「仅播客」模式引导（仅播客模式隐藏首页并将资料库与搜索默认切至播客；可随时在 设置 → 外观 → 杂项 中更改）。
- **内容过滤：** 新增仅露骨歌曲、AI 艺人屏蔽、视频与短音频过滤，以及不影响 Open RSS 的隐藏 YouTube 播客选项。
- **Apple Music 视觉增强：** 新增动态专辑封面、艺人图片与艺人个人资料视频，支持分辨率限制与移动网络开关。
- **统一歌词体验与封面过渡：** 为所有用户默认启用 Apple Music 逐字歌词样式，新增实时预览、字号与行距调节、渐进模糊、展开/收起歌词时的封面缩放过渡，以及底部词曲作者与来源署名。
- **现代播放器与自定义图标：** 统一采用新版播放器与迷你播放器设计，恢复随系统切换的深色模式默认图标，并在 设置 → 外观 中新增应用图标切换（默认 / 钢琴黑键）。
- **问题修复：** 修复网页登录、首页与搜索页选歌播放队列、播客搜索下点击底部导航栏返回、歌词跳转响应、切换逐字样式即时生效、艺人视频比例与底部淡出高度，以及 Discord Rich Presence / Last.fm 同步稳定性。

## 更新说明

- 需要 **Android 8.0 或更新系统，以及 ARM64 设备**。
- 使用与历史正式版一致的长期证书签名，可直接覆盖升级安装。
- Open RSS 播客与订阅源不受 YouTube 专用内容过滤影响。
- Apple Music 动态封面、艺人图片与艺人视频均为可选开关，并提供画质与移动数据控制。
- Apple Music 逐字歌词已为所有用户默认启用，可随时前往 设置 → 外观 → 歌词 中切换其他样式或关闭。
